test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Advanced Full Test - 05
subject: general
question: Seven friends P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table facing towards the center. V is third to the left of S. Q is third to the right of R. P is second to the left of T. U sits immediate left of R. P sits immediate right of S. Who is second to the left of V?
solution:
**Seven friends:** P, Q, R, S, T, U and V.

1) V is third to the left of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6449104ef5fe6be13c9d5a90251d83e0d1bc88ee8f83e64a6f3dbc0ddc6a859.png] 

2) P sits immediate right of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/427ca4e564e0c057e17f42c53cc70ce3f48852220ca9cf0e85ccb5a161f8ebe7.png] 

3) P is second to the left of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/249b3cee6deb1eb428e35788b706a7c88225b370d24ad57d64268db17d063490.png] 

4) Q is third to the right of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c53a5657517e706d0657e6939777d9064b238ce359e1d117d2568802611ee7fe.png] 

5) U sits immediate left of R.

So, case -1 gets eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a27557327c9563959ba6b191002177534c79f0f4cc024d77218c3cff4f725b13.png] 

Q is Second to the left of V.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Q".**
